title: 第1611章 接触帷幕第1610章 后时代
slug: 从鹰人进化为天使后我荡平诸神
lines: “浩劫？千年前可没有这场历史，我原本以为，这是一本记录了虚假的书籍，只不过真的沉淀了千年。”
“但书籍里的其他事物太过真实，在历史和现实中皆有所存，这就让我渐渐相信了。”
“于是，在阅读之中，我不知不觉地进入了一处神秘的所在。”
“那是一处完全不同于现实世界的地方，就像是世界的另一面。”
“在那里，我觉醒了超凡的力量，并且渐渐变强。”
“不过，我也只是在摸索。”
“因为实力弱小，我只敢在那处神秘所在的边缘行动，因为在往里面，我隐隐约约看到了一道道阴暗可怖的黑影，徘徊在灰雾的深处。”
“它们在不断厮嚎，互相攻杀，实力强大的可怕。”
“所以我不敢深入。”
“后来，我遇到了很多有着同样经历的超凡者，我们之间相互交流，摸索晋升的方法。”
“对于那处神秘的地域，我们称之为“帷幕之后。”
“帷幕之后。”
天使露娜目光幽然，透过虚无的距离，似乎想要看透眼前凡人口中所说的“帷幕”。
她微微沉神，意识到这是新的超凡体系，也是新时代的象征。
“帷幕体系，已经有一定的规模了。”
“看来，我已经落后了一千年。”
她看着眼前的年轻超凡者笑道。
“感谢你的告知，年轻人。”
“你让我明悟了新时代的大门从何而开。”
“我名露娜·安温尔，繁星文明的代政者，如果将来你有什么需求，可以向星政厅提出，他们会报告到我这里。”
年轻的超凡者听到天使露娜的名字，顿时惊喜无比。
“您是露娜殿下！“
他忍不住行礼。
“向您致敬，伟大的代政者殿下，繁星文明的守护天使，我是卡斯尔。”
虽然大衰败时代，正常世界的超凡没落，如今的繁星文明各大区域，总督区，国度区，资源区，都很少见到超凡者的身影了。
因为强大的超凡者不仅稀少，也集中在文明的核心区域，大部分边缘地区都很少再有超凡者的身影。
以前低级超凡者的职能也被装备着机甲等高科技战斗兵器的星际警察部队代替。
但是，即便是这样。
强大的超凡者依旧活跃在文明之上，比如天使露娜，便是七境至尊，属于超凡巅峰，依旧执掌着文明权柄。
卡斯尔见到天使露娜，就像是普通人见到国家元首一般，自然无比激动。
“不如如此激动，我微服私访，动静不易太大。”
“哦哦，好的好的。”
卡斯尔激动点头。
“我记住你了，卡斯尔。”
“我现在还有一个问题，你既然知道很多帷幕体系的超凡者，那么他们的觉醒超凡的方式，都是什么？”
“我也想去帷幕之后看看。”
露娜·安温尔认真问道。
卡斯尔闻言，略微思索，开口道。
“殿下，我们这群人经过很多次聚会。”
“在这些聚会中，我们一般都是在讨论如何完成超凡的晋升，已经如何减少进入帷幕带来的影响。”
“但我们也曾聊过关于觉醒超凡的途径。”
“在多次交谈之中，我们发现，我们了一个共同点。”
content_en:
"Catastrophe? There was no history like this a thousand years ago. I originally thought that this was a book that recorded falsehoods, but it was really accumulated for thousands of years."
"But other things in the books were too real and existed in history and reality, which gradually made me believe it."
"So, while reading, I unknowingly entered a mysterious place."
"It was a completely different place from the real world, like the other side of the world."
"There, I awakened my extraordinary power and gradually became stronger."
"But I'm just exploring."
"Because I am weak, I only dare to act on the edge of that mysterious place, because when I went inside, I vaguely saw dark and terrifying black shadows, lingering in the depths of the gray fog."
"They are constantly howling and attacking each other. They are terrifyingly powerful."
"So I'm afraid to go deep."
"Later, I met many extraordinary people who had the same experience. We communicated with each other and explored ways to advance."
"We call that mysterious area "Behind the Curtain." "
“Behind the Curtain. "
Angel Luna's eyes were dim, looking through the distance of nothingness, as if she wanted to see through what mortals call the "curtain" in front of her.
She sank slightly and realized that this was a new extraordinary system and a symbol of a new era.
“The curtain system already has a certain scale. "
“It seems that I am a thousand years behind. "
She looked at the young transcendent in front of her and smiled.
"Thank you for the information, young man. "
"You made me understand where the door to a new era opens. "
"My name is Luna Anwenl, the acting administrator of the Starry Civilization. If you have any needs in the future, you can submit them to the Star Government Office and they will report them to me. "
When the young extraordinary person heard the name of Angel Luna, he was immediately surprised.
"You are Your Highness Luna! "
He couldn't help but salute.
"Homage to you, His Highness the Great Regulator, Guardian Angel of Starry Civilization, I am Castle. "
Despite the Great Decline and the decline of the extraordinary in the normal world, extraordinary people are rarely seen in today's major regions of the Starry Civilization, including the Governor's Area, the Country Area, and the Resource Area.
Because powerful extraordinary beings are not only rare, they are also concentrated in the core areas of civilization, and there are very few extraordinary beings in most peripheral areas.
The functions of low-level extraordinary beings in the past have been replaced by interstellar police forces equipped with high-tech combat weapons such as mechas.
But even so.
Powerful extraordinary beings are still active in civilization, such as the angel Luna, who is the Supreme of the Seven Realms, belongs to the pinnacle of extraordinary beings, and still controls the authority of civilization.
When Castle saw Angel Luna, he was just like an ordinary person meeting the head of state, so he was naturally extremely excited.
"It's better to be so excited. I'll pay a private visit incognito, so the noise won't be too big. "
“Oh oh, okay, okay. "
Castle nodded excitedly.
"I remember you, Castle. "
"I have another question now. Since you know many extraordinary beings in the Veil System, what are their methods of awakening to extraordinaryness? "
“I also want to see Behind the Curtain. "
Luna Anwen asked seriously.
After hearing this, Castle thought for a moment and said.
“Your Highness, our group has been through many gatherings. "
"In these gatherings, we usually discuss how to achieve extraordinary promotion and how to reduce the impact of entering the Veil. "
“But we also talked about the path to transcendent awakening. "
“After many conversations, we discovered that we had one thing in common. "
title_en: Chapter 1611: Contact with the Curtain Chapter 1610: Post-Era
